id: title:andrewm4894:anchor deferred shadow scoring on the champion s people

review.posthog_relevance: Adds support for fixed anchor person IDs and cleanup of scored persons in the inference scoring workflow, potentially supporting deferred shadow scoring and preventing stale person ID retention.
review.reason: The change introduces a new SQL builder and parameters for fixed anchor person IDs, along with cleanup mechanisms for scored persons. While the implementation of the scoring and the `discard_scored_persons` function is not supplied in this chunk, the addition of these parameters and the cleanup calls suggests a substantive, bounded capability improvement. review.uncertainty: The implementation and scoring of the anchor_person_ids and the discard_scored_persons function are not supplied, so the benefit is unverified.

observations.behavior: Adds a new SQL builder, build_fixed_anchors_sql, and its callers, P1.F1.H1
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a fixed, non-rolling anchor set for downstream scoring, replacing the rolling selection. This could preserve the exact population scored by a champion even if the underlying person table changes, rather than re-selecting from the population. This could support deferred shadow scoring against the same people without re-querying the population.

observations.behavior: Adds anchor_person_ids parameter to build_inference_features_sql, P1.F2.H2
observations.posthog_connection: Allows downstream callers to pass a fixed anchor set, rather than relying on rolling selection. This could support the deferred shadow scoring use case, where the shadow set is scored against the same people as the champion, rather than a rolling subset.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test asserting that when an autoresearch pipeline is deleted or archived, the scoring activity calls a cleanup function to remove stored person IDs.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a test for the cleanup behavior of the scoring activity, not the implementation of the cleanup itself.

observations.posthog_connection: These functions are imported into the workflow, suggesting they are invoked during scoring, but the invocation and implementation are not shown in this chunk.

observations.behavior: Adds a branch that calls discard_scored_persons_for when the run or pipeline is missing, and retains the existing call to discard_scored_persons when the pipeline is live but status is not live.
observations.posthog_connection: This chunk implements the cleanup of stored person IDs when the pipeline or run is missing, and retains the cleanup when the pipeline is live but status is not live. This could prevent stale person IDs from remaining in object storage after pipeline deletion or status change.
